change_summary: Let external Agents read one bounded, hash-bound retained source without creating a writeful Question, and carry typed continuation handles without copying receipt prefixes into tool arguments.

canonical_skill.note: The shared Skill keeps the handoff weak while preferring a bounded read-only Asset projection when the task needs facts from one retained source.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-12.1 adds an optional read-only Asset content projection with explicit hash, completeness, truncation, policy and current-revision authority; metadata-only behavior remains the default.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.24 with collaboration contract 2026-09-12.1.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.25 adds files get --content as the same bounded read-only source projection exposed by Remote MCP.

help_center.note: Help explains when to use a bounded source projection, what its completeness receipts mean, and why it does not replace organization or exact-byte download.

package_setup.note: The existing Claude Plugin hook remains compatible; terminal receipt completeness is carried by the canonical Skill.

harness_and_mainline.note: Natural J3T2 exposed typed-handle misuse and a missing external read path even though the internal Work Model loop already had the correct hash-bound source authority.

external_marketplaces.note: The official package publication is first-party; the two-host fresh acceptance matrix remains runtime evidence and WorkBuddy is outside this cycle.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover content projection policy and source receipts, typed host handles, MCP schema, CLI transport and published package metadata; fresh post-release J3T2 is the next semantic behavior gate.
